reviews.title: Cameras are okay—app is horrible!
reviews.text:
When you have multiple cameras, each recording several hundred clips during the day; well, good luck finding what you need in the clips!!!

Yes the feed has ways to set a filter to show, but you can’t filter at the time you are looking for something (like to view “person” only). And if you have five cameras; well, again, good luck!

In addition to not having the ability to filter by video type (which to me is common sense to have), there is no way to go to specific time range of day (or to quickly jump to a specific hour).

If you want to go back to a several date, you can select the date that takes you to midnight, but then you are scrolling through a ton of clips to get to a time range you are looking for in that day.  And when you scroll through the videos you a searching, the videos get messed up eventually, start spinning or not loading  (and I have have gig fiber, mesh network, a one-year old phone, so it’s the app and not my phone/connection). Once the clips freeze, you have to go back out of the video scrolling—and it will usually reset where you were and go back to the current date and time; and you have to go start searching all over again!!!

So although the cameras seem to be okay (well, they are “okay” after they took 8 months to fix the bug causing the pro gen 6 to always record in black and white), the app is HORRIBLE if you ever need to go back to find something. For seeing the most recent clips, it’s okay: but a security camera isn’t really much of a “securit

The App Store’s summary is not a genuine representation of what users think. I am a user of over 5 years and I do not appreciate ANY of the features and the camera quality is utterly appalling.
What’s more this is my third attempt at a review today and they are not being posted. It seems that App Store only like positive reviews and only accept poor reviews that do not carry meaningful content and can therefore be easily dismissed. This is the worst spend of £1000 I have ever made. The app is a confounding convoluted utter disaster and the cameras are shocking. You cannot read a vehicle registration at 12 feet. You cannot make out a person’s face 12 feet away. The recording is utterly utterly flaky to the extent that I’ve had several Police visits to my home requesting doorbell footage of possible incidents and every single time, there is nothing there because the camera picked nothing up. Even if it had, the officers would barely be able to make out the person’s gender, let alone identify them, unless they were stood directly at my front door glaring directly into the camera at a range of about 30cm.

reviews.text:

reviews.title: App is absolute rubbish - but so is the rest of the software on the units.
reviews.text:
To clarify, the quality of the images on the camera is great, the underlying software is absolute trash.

I constantly have issues with the app failing to understand geo locations. Occasionally enables remote away, at other times you have to open the app for it to realise you are nowhere close to the area, then it realises it was meant to enable the away mode,
I have never been able to get the camera to automatically go to home mode when arriving home. Despite having setup two users, it only recognises me and not my partners geo location.

Hardware wise gone through two floodlight pros, both of which don’t charge properly or won’t report an updated battery charge level after being plugged in for hours.

Internal cameras that drop off the network and fail to reconnect resulting in a physical power cycle to get them communicating, despite being within 4m line of sight to an access point.

Had to move all the cameras bar the doorbell off the Arlo Secure HUB because they frequently become unresponsive.

reviews.text:
Slow
The delay and lag is poor (worse than our former system)

Most alarms are things like a tea towel on a washing line it thinks is a person
Also mistaking cats and moths as people thus triggering alarm 

So I’m calling this unfit for purpose
Almost deliberately BAD so you have to pay extra for their AI filter (who I assume can tell the difference between a moth and a person a cat and a trespassing human)

I wasted my money on a whole xxtv set up and doorbell
I regret it bitterly as the software behind it is half baked and not fit for purpose 
One could ague its ‘entrapment’ by providing something g so dire as basic and useless that you have to pay extra for its AI service (which ought to be standard)

However maybe some people would like an alarm going off every time a moth flies by?

reviews.title: Stay Away from arlo and their products
reviews.text:
I’ve owned Arlo products for many years, but the app experience has gone seriously downhill.

The app was never perfect, but it used to give you quick and easy access to your cloud videos and, importantly, your locally recorded footage. Now, finding locally recorded videos feels unnecessarily difficult, with important features buried under multiple menus.

It’s particularly frustrating because local recordings can be extremely important when you need to review footage after suspicious or unwanted activity at your property. Yet the app seems to prioritise subscription and premium features instead. There’s even a prominent button dedicated to calling a friend, while accessing your own locally recorded security footage is made far less obvious.

It increasingly feels like the app is designed to push users towards paying a subscription rather than simply providing a good experience for people who have already invested in Arlo hardware.

After years of using Arlo products, I’m left feeling that this is another company trying to milk more money from its customers without providing enough additional value in return. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Identical results to existing app
reviews.text:
The latest app is still full of inconvenient elements and no big improvement over what was already a far from ideal interface. 

Now it’s just a harder to use and a more time consuming change, why change from a horizontal time line into a ridiculous space wasting vertical layout for ‘Feeds’? 

It is impossible to quickly jump from one day’ videos to another especially if there is a week’s worth to check. There isn’t a way to selectively select contiguous clips to delete without clicking each individual clip.

Now the video scroll/time bar has disappeared from each running clip and has been replaced by a “Live Camera” shortcut. Completely unnecessary!

 Something that was always desperately required was a more flexible scheduling control, for instance the ability to easily schedule individual cameras to run and switch off.

I still haven’t managed to get the back garden cameras to switch on at dusk and switch off at 10:00am while,leaving the street side cameras (which are hardwired) to remain on 24/7.It’s not been improved. the latest version of the app has added some extra flexibility but the ‘Routines’ section is confusing and over complicated and inflexible.

 More customisation on camera settings would also help, a more flexible maximum field of detection, longer maximum time of each camera’s individual recording. This would be helpful especially for wired in or solar powered cameras where battery life is irrelevant.

We have long winters... One camera needs recharging almost every day since it picks up every little movement or noise, you can adjust sensitivity to what they detect, for time period you want detection, subscribe monthly for video storage, etc. Audio is fair to poor when trying to converse with someone on a camera. Hubby being second user, most of the time has difficulty accessing cameras away from home on his iphone. All in all, we purchased a 3 pack camera system....spent additional money on covers and posts to attach 2 of them to since they did not work well on the gutters where we originally had placed them. We purchased 3 additional boosters for better wifi access so they wouldn’t lose their connections. We spent a LOT OF MONEY getting these cameras up and running....would we do it again....probably not.

reviews.title: Good but room for improvement
reviews.text: Would be nice to see more of a lean toward people without a subscription but who have invested in all the gear, including base stations for storage. Having the cloud v local button not show up for a while each time you try is frustrating as is the constant prompts to get a subscription. Recently and for the past six weeks, going to full screen on the cameras will freeze the app and nothing but a close and reopen will bring it back.

reviews.title: Poorly designed
reviews.text:
Incredibly frustrating to use on an iPad due to some very poor usability design. For example when playing a video there is plenty of space above and below the video to have a back button. Which would be standard practice. But no, you have to tap the screen once which then shows a tiny icon in the top right. You then have to tap this which has a tiny hit zone so you have to be spot on accurate. This still doesn’t take you back to the previous screen, instead there is now another back button on the top left which takes you back. And if you don’t tap these things in sequence quickly enough the whole thing fades, and you have to start again. Just amateurish software design. And that’s just one of many examples.

I purchased the Arlo Pro 3 floodlight cameras. Multiple cameras in fact. They work quite well but also have their own problems. There is a constant crackling sound on the audio channel (this happens on all of the cameras). They are also quite laggy. If you are watching a live stream, it’s not live at all it’s about 10 or 15 seconds delayed. So, overall, adequate, but really not that impressive.

reviews.title: Was great for about a year
reviews.text:
I had a standalone Arlo floodlight camera with no base unit. It worked really great with the app on my phone for about a year. We experienced some very cold temperatures over the winter, and the camera stopped working. I tried to reach out for tech-support, but it seems that I didn’t pay enough monthly to warrant in person support. The only option I had was to change my subscription to almost triple what I was paying every month, or use their online troubleshooting tips. None of the online tips worked so I went to Reddit and a couple of other places to try to find additional information. In the end, I never got the camera working again, as I refuse to pay that much for a subscription to a camera that I paid $200 for. I bought it because of their lower monthly subscription prices. But I guess I should have read the fine print. The camera itself was great while it worked, and the app was fairly user-friendly. The reason for three stars is solely because of how much they charge to get some customer service when their product stops working.
Updated: I actually took a star away because of the response to my original review.
As you will see below, they will send you to some troubleshooting tips online, even if you say you have already done all of that. And if you don’t pay enough monthly, you will have no other recourse. There were no “other options”.

reviews.title: Custom modes
reviews.text: The current app is too restrictive in building custom modes. The previous app allowed build of a custom mode in which the user could decide which cameras were included in the mode, and each camera’s activation could be configured individually. The current app allows inclusion of multiple cameras, but the cameras are activated based on the setting of only one camera in the new custom mode. For instance: In a new mode with 4 cameras, cameras 2,3, and 4 do nothing until camera 1 detracts movement. I have cameras inside and outside of my home. At times, I only want to arm the exterior cameras. I want my backyard camera to activate independently of my front driveway camera. Also, when I’m trying to access the app, and view a camera because it just alerted me to movement, that is NOT the time to try selling me something or ask me to rate your app! I’m heavily invested in your devices. (8 HD cameras and doorbell) I’ve been a monthly subscriber since you first started. In theory your product sounds great. But in reality, you over promise and under deliver. Video quality is poor, huge latency and lag in response, and numerous system errors. If not for the large cost and wasted investment, I would remove Arlo and move to something else. And I’ll stop ranting now. This “review” is long enough already. In summary, please fix the app with true custom mode capability.

reviews.title: Underperforming System
reviews.text: We’ve had a 4-camera system in place nearly 5 years. Three of the cameras use solar panels for charging and the other is charged manually. Two of the panels quit working after 3 years, despite regular inspections and changing a few cables.  It’s now quite an effort to take them down each month to charge them.  My main complaint is the system. The camera’s sensitivity is poor at best. Three of the 4 have unobstructed views.  They are stationary and must be moved manually! The one mounted above our 30’ driveway rarely detects our vehicles entering or leaving our garage nor does it detect an individual walking or on a bike doing the same. The system has a delay that usually only records as they a disappearing from sight . The same is said for our camera facing our front yard and walkway to our front door. St best we catch the back of a delivery man or solicitor’s head as he reaches the sidewalk by the street. We’ve adjusted height, angles and even switched camera around to no avail. We followed a suggestion to upgrade our internet speed/capability with no improvement.  We’ve since added a 2nd independent system to enhance our security.  The new cameras can be operated remotely and can cover a 360’ view. Knowing what I do now, I would not recommend the system . Perhaps Arlo has made improvements. We’ll never know.

reviews.title: Poor AI
reviews.text: The software isn’t intuitive. Calling Tech Support is often a struggle as everyone has a foreign accent and they speak too fast. I have called and have simply given up. I have cars being identified on my deck. I have used the geometric screens to block driveways and streets; I have one camera that points down but uses the screens to block the neighbor in the side yard but still get people warnings; there is a tree near a camera that is also screened but when the wind blows it detects an animal. So I have to review those videos and there is nothing there in the areas where I need to see activity. Also, when the batteries need changed, I have to lean out a second floor window, use an Allen wrench to pop the camera out of the mount, bring it inside to replace the battery, then put the camera back in the mount. Often, the 3D mount may get moved so the digital screen no longer is where you had it before which is why it detects road or sidewalk motion on my back deck. I have learned that one should NOT call tech support but rather use chat if you have trouble communicating verbally over the phone. However I am 76 and type with one finger, so I have had agents just terminate have  the chat  session without checking to see if I am still there. Very Frustrating!!!
